features.name: Mercy Domain Spells
features.description:
| Cleric Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 1st | divine favor, healing word |
| 3rd | aid, ray of enfeeblement |
| 5th | bardo, revivify |
| 7th | death ward, sacrificial healing |
| 9th | antilife shell, raise dead |

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: When you choose this domain at 1st level, you gain proficiency in Medicine and with the poisoner's kit. You also gain proficiency with heavy armor and martial weapons.

features.name: Threshold Guardian
features.description: Also at 1st level, when you hit a creature that doesn't have all of its HP with a melee weapon attack, the weapon deals extra radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) equal to half your proficiency bonus.

features.name: Channel Divinity: Involuntary Aid
features.description: Starting at 2nd level, as an action, present your holy symbol to one creature within 30 ft that doesn't have all its HP. WIS save: fail = takes radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) equal to 3 × cleric level; success = half damage. Then one friendly creature within 30 ft you can see regains HP equal to the damage dealt.

features.name: Bolster the Living
features.description: At 6th level, when a creature you can see dies within 30 feet of you, you can use your reaction to channel a portion of that energy into a friendly creature within 30 ft. That creature gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to half your proficiency bonus until the end of its next turn.

payload.name: Bolster the Living
payload.description: When a creature dies within 30 ft, channel its energy into a friendly creature within 30 ft: bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to half prof bonus until end of its next turn.

features.name: Divine Strike of Mercy
features.description: At 8th level, once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, deal extra 1d6 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice). If the target dies from this attack, a friendly creature within 5 ft regains HP equal to half the damage dealt (or you regain if none are within 5 ft). Increases to 2d6 at 14th level.

features.name: Hand of Grace and Execution
features.description: At 17th level, once per turn, if you cast a spell that restores HP to one creature or deals damage to one creature, add your proficiency bonus to the HP restored or damage dealt.
